item.title: One of the World’s Craziest Waves Explained by the Guy Who Found It
item.description: Weird waves have been all the rage for the last little while. The people who discovered one of the weirdest have released a video explaining how it came to be.

item.title: Surfboard Maker …Lost Suffers Setback in Lawsuit Against Lady Gaga
item.description: A judge's decision dealt a major blow to Matt Biolos helmed surfboard maker ...Lost's trademark infringement case against Lady Gaga, but the fight isn't over.

item.title: Soli Bailey Goes From the Operating Room to the Green Room
item.description: Soli Bailey fell and ruptured a disc in his neck that pressed into his spinal cord. Surgery, rehab, and setbacks weren't going to keep him out of the water.

item.title: ‘Point Break’ is Getting a TV Adaptation
item.description: AMC is developing a TV adaptation of the surf movie classic 'Point Break.'

item.title: New Study Finds Microscopic Particles ‘Surf on the Waves of the Microcosm’
item.description: Microscopic particles save energy by surfing from one place to another. Do you think the particles lie about the size of their waves too?

item.title: The Notorious ‘Gurgle Slab’ Returned and Nate Florence Was On It
item.description: When the waves get weird, Nate Florence wants to surf them. And one of the weirdest waves on the North Shore, the notorious "Gurgle Slab" made its return.

item.title: Bondi Beach Lifeguards Were First on the Scene of Mass Shooting, Saved Lives Under Gunfire
item.description: As reports emerge from the tragic mass shooting at Bondi Beach in Australia, people on the ground say that lifeguards were the first to respond.

item.title: WSL Takes Legal Action Against Pedro Scooby for Criticizing Judges at Saquarema Event
item.description: A day after big-wave surfer Pedro Scooby competed in the Nazaré Big Wave Challenge, news broke that the WSL is filing legal proceedings against him in Brazil.

item.title: A Deceased Hiker’s Smartwatch Helped Authorities Piece Together a Bear Attack
item.description: The smartwatch of a man who was fatally attacked by a brown bear on the Japanese island of Hokkaido sadly contains clues to the final minutes of his life.

item.title: Hawaii Spearfisherman Gets Bitten by Shark, Calls Mother, Takes Bong Rip
item.description: Kaimani Ventura, 24, had a horrific encounter with a shark while diving off the Big Island, as he recounts in an Instagram video describing the ordeal.
